rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they cannot meet the challenge, they should submit, believe, and abandon the obstinacy that leads to the Fire.
rows.anchor: فاذعنوا وأسلموا وآمنوا، واتركوا العناد المفضي بكم إلى النار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The omitted necessary response is faith or Islam; avoiding the Fire stands in its place, making denial's punishment explicit.
rows.anchor: فحذف الملزوم الذي هو الإيمان أو الإسلام، وأقام لازمه الذي هو اتقاء النار مقامه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prediction that they will never meet the challenge is an unseen report, since veiled minds cannot produce its like.
rows.anchor: اعتراض على طريق الإخبار بالغيب للعلم بامتناع عقول المحجوبين عن مثله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Fire is the souls' burning turmoil and lower nature, cut off from holy spirit, merciful savor, certainty, and peace while still longing for bodily pleasures and familiar attachments.
rows.anchor: احتراقهم بثورة نفوسهم، وشرر طباعهم المصروفة عن الروح القدسي الروحاني، والنسيم الذوقي الرحماني،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Its fuel is the harsh, lower, inert things people loved; their forms root in the soul and imprison it through attachment.
rows.anchor: الأمور الجاسية، السفلية، الصامتة، التي تعلقوا بها بالمحبة فرسخت صورتها في أنفسهم،

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet says a person is gathered with what he loves, even if one loves a stone and is gathered with it.
rows.anchor: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Love embeds the beloved's image in the self until it becomes the heart's own image; the Fire's heat follows its spiritual species and kingdom, not merely its body.
rows.anchor: وقد ركزت صورته في نفسه بالمحبة بحيث صار صورة قلبه صورته.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Spiritual fire descends through levels; anger can burn moral character more than fire burns wood, so warmth does not always mean heat.
rows.anchor: وتلك الروحانية شرر من نار، قهر الله المعنوية بعد تنزلها في مراتب كثيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Physical fire derives from spiritual fire, making Hell's pain more intense and lasting; bodily powers are finite and weaker than spiritual powers.
rows.anchor: إذا كانت النار الجسمانية أثرا للنار الروحانية، فلا جرم أن إيلامها أشد وأدوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He reports the saying that Hellfire was washed with water seventy times before being sent down to the world for use.
rows.anchor: يقال: إن نار جهنم غسلت بالماء سبعين مرة، ثم أنزلت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers are those veiled from religion and cut off from attaining what they seek.
rows.anchor: المحجوبين عن الدين لانقطاعهم دون مرادهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question asks how they can be veiled from God.
rows.anchor: أي: على أي حال تحجبون عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being dead refers to semen in the fathers' loins; their creation should lead them to infer the Creator.
rows.anchor: أي: لم لا تستدلون بالخلق على الخالق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ordinarily this is natural death, resurrection, and return for recompense; the first creation is observable and supports inference to resurrection.
rows.anchor: إذ الأول معلوم بالمشاهدة، والثاني بالاستدلال عليه بالإنشاء الأول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, death is voluntary annihilation of the self in unity, followed by true life as abiding through the Real's bestowed existence.
rows.anchor: بالموت الإرادي الذي هو الفناء في الوحدة ثم يحييكم بالحياة الحقيقية التي هي البقاء بعد الفناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Return means witnessing if unity is of the attributes, or vision if unity is of the Essence.
rows.anchor: للمشاهدة إن كانت الوحدة وحدة الصفات، أو الشهود إن كانت وحدة الذات

words: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Everything on earth means the lower elemental realm, source and material of human creation, existence, and continuance.
rows.anchor: الجهة السفلية التي هي العالم العنصري جميعا لكونها مبادئ خلقكم ومواد وجودكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The turn to the upper realm marks the difference between realms and creative acts, not a time gap that would put earth before heaven.
rows.anchor: وثم للتفاوت بين الجهتين والإيجادين الإبداعي والتكويني لا للتراخي بين الزمانين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the common outward account, the apparent Throne and Footstool are the eighth and ninth.
rows.anchor: فعدلهن سبع سموات بحسب ما تراه العامة، إذ الثمن والتاسع هو الكرسي والعرش الظاهران

words: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inwardly the lower realm is bodily, like a body, while heaven is the higher-ranking spiritual world; the transition distinguishes creation from command.
rows.anchor: الحقيقة أن الجهة السفلية هي العالم الجسماني كالبدن وأعضائه لدنو رتبته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The seven heavens signify levels: earthly malakut, psychic powers and jinn, then soul, heart, intellect, secret, spirit, and hidden spiritual secret.
rows.anchor: الأول: هو عالم الملكوت الأرضية والقوى النفسانية والجن.

rows.speaker: أمير المؤمنين
rows.claim: ʿAlī says he knows heaven's paths better than earth's; these paths are states and stations such as asceticism, trust, and contentment.
rows.anchor: وإلى هذا أشار أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام بقوله:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Terminology differs: philosophers call spirit what Sufis call intellect; the Sufi intellect here is the rational soul's faculty, while the heart is the rational soul illuminated by spirit.
rows.anchor: العقل باصطلاح الحكمة هو الروح باصطلاح أهل التصوف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The time reference points to eternity; God's saying casts His will to create Adam into sacred angelic and spiritual beings.
rows.anchor: إذ: إشارة إلى السرمد الذي هو من الأزل إلى الأبد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every created event first has a form in the spirit world of prior decree, then the heart-world of the Preserved Tablet, then the soul-world, Tablet of Effacement and Affirmation or lowest heaven.
rows.anchor: كل ما يحدث في عالم الكون له صورة قبل التكوين في عالم الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human speech and action similarly exist first in spirit and deeper unseen levels, then the self's lower unseen level, before appearing on the limbs.
rows.anchor: فإن كل ما يظهر على جوارحك التي هي عالم كونك وشهادتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Making is broader than origination or formation, so God says 'making' rather than 'creating'; the human combines the two worlds.
rows.anchor: والجعل أعم من الإبداع والتكوين، فلم يقل (خالق) لأن الإنسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The human vicegerent takes on God's traits, executes His command, governs creation, orders its affairs, and calls people to obedience.
rows.anchor: خليفة يتخلق بأخلاقي، ويتصف بأوصافي

words: أَتَجْعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفْسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسْفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels' objection and claim to precedence reflect their inability to see divine attributes manifest uniquely in the human composite encompassing both worlds.
rows.anchor: هو احتجابهم عن ظهور معنى الإلهية والأوصاف الربانية فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Corruption and bloodshed signify beastly lust and predatory anger, powers necessary when spirit is joined to body; angels know their own purity and these lower acts.
rows.anchor: الأفعال البهيمية التي هي الإفساد في الأرض، والسبعية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each angelic rank knows what is below and within itself but not above; they see the soul as evil-bearing intermediary between luminous spirit and dark body.
rows.anchor: كل طبقة من الملائكة المقدسة تطلع على ما تحتها وما في أنفسها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels do not know that human comprehensiveness attracts divine light, the secret of God's statement that He knows what they do not.
rows.anchor: ولا تعلم أن الجمعية الإنسانية جالبة للنور الإلهي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Glorification denies partner, incapacity, and defect; sanctification also denies attachment, passivity, contingency, multiplicity, and potentiality, so every sanctified being glorifies but not vice versa.
rows.anchor: والفرق بين التسبيح والتقديس، أن التسبيح: هو التنزيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The nearest angels, pure spirits, are sanctifiers because they are un-veiled, overcome lower realms with light, act on others, and possess all perfections actually; other angels glorify.
rows.anchor: الملائكة المقربون الذين هم الأرواح المجردة بتجردهم وعدم احتجابهم عن نور ربهم

words: لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى ٱللَّهَ جَهْرَةًۭ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their refusal means they would not attain true faith through Moses' guidance until reaching direct witnessing and vision.
rows.anchor: لأجل هدايتك الإيمان الحقيقي حتى تصل إلى مقام المشاهدة والعيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The thunderbolt is death as annihilation in the self-disclosure of the Essence; they were observing or witnessing it.
rows.anchor: صاعقة الموت الذي هو الفناء في التجلي الذاتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their revival is true life and abiding after annihilation, so they can thank God for unity and arrival through the path in God.
rows.anchor: بالحياة الحقيقية والبقاء بعد الفناء لكي تشكروا نعمة التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cloud is the manifestation of attributes, which veils the wholly scorching sun of the Essence.
rows.anchor: غمام تجلي الصفات لكونها حجب شمس الذات المحرقة بالكلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Manna and quails signify tasting-stations that sweeten and purge the soul, such as trust and contentment, along with wisdom and true knowledge sent by divine mercy.
rows.anchor: من الأحوال والمقامات الذوقية الجامعة بين الحلاوة وإسهال رذائل أخلاق النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eating means receiving and taking in these good things.
rows.anchor: أي: تناولوا وتلقوا هذه الطيبات

words: وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They did not diminish God's rights or attributes; veiling themselves with ego traits deprived and wronged their own selves.
rows.anchor: ما نقصوا حقوقنا وصفاتنا باحتجابهم بصفات نفوسهم

words: وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although the address is general under either interpretation, it specifically concerns the seventy chosen ones.
rows.anchor: والخطجاب وإن كان عاما لكنه مخصوص بالسبعين المختارين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The addressees fell from innate nature, veiled from original preparedness; they kill themselves through misguidance and caprice.
rows.anchor: الساقطون عن الفطرة، المحتجبون عن نور الاستعداد الأصلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Expelling a group from home means leading them from their primordial homeland by misguiding them and inciting sin and caprice.
rows.anchor: أوطانهم القديمة الأصلية، بإغوائهم وإضلالهم وتحريضهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Helping them in sin and aggression means committing vice so they follow, extending injustice, and imposing and embellishing animal and predatory vices, as antinomian Muslim claimants of unity do.
rows.anchor: وتزيينكم لهم إياها كما هو عادة ملاحدة المسلمين من أهل الإباحة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prisoners are bound by consequences and shame of their actions; their minds reproach them for the disgrace incurred.
rows.anchor: في قيد تبعات ارتكبوها وشين أفعالهم القبيحة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ransoming them means offering wisdom and counsel about higher pleasures and the ruin of following ego, soul, and Satan, briefly awakening them from caprice.
rows.anchor: بكلمات الحكمة والموعظة والنصيحة الدالة على أن اللذات المستعلية هي: العقلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believing part means verbally affirming the book of intellect and revelation, including that following caprice is blameworthy and brings ruin.
rows.anchor: كتاب العقل والشرع قولا وإقرارا، فتقرون به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disbelieving in part means failing to stop what is forbidden and instead permitting prohibited acts.
rows.anchor: فعلا وعملا فلا تنتهون عما نهاكم عنه، وهو

words: فَمَا جَزَآءُ مَن يَفْعَلُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their penalty is humiliation in worldly life and at separation, the lesser resurrection, then severe punishment from entrenched dark dispositions or total transformation of their forms.
rows.anchor: أي: حال المفارقة التي هي القيامة الصغرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has counted and recorded their deeds within them, as stated in 58:6.
rows.anchor: أحصاها وضبطها في أنفسكم وكتبها عليكم، كما قال تعالى:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abrogation can cancel a ruling while retaining wording and meaning, or retain wording without meaning, as with the stoning verse.
rows.anchor: بإبطال حكمها وإبقاء لفظها ومعناها، أو لفظها دون معناها، كآية الرجم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A replacement is better when more fitting in its domain, or equal in goodness and benefit.
rows.anchor: بما هو أصلح في بابه منها في بابها أو يساويها في الخير والصلاح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Preserved-Tablet rulings may be specific to persons, lasting while they live, or periods, ending with their era; short periods include abrogated Quran rulings and long ones earlier dispensations. The Tablet records this condition; general rulings endure.
rows.anchor: الأحكام المثبتة في اللوح المحفوظ إما مخصوصة وإما عامة،

words: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heavens and earth are the spiritual and bodily worlds; God controls both, outwardly and inwardly, so none besides can support or protect you.
rows.anchor: له ملك سموات عالم الأرواح وأرض الأجساد وهو المتصرف فيهما بيد قدرته

words: إني وجهت وجهي للذي فطر السماوات والأرض
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Black Stone signifies spirit; Abu Qubays shaking and opening to reveal it signifies its emergence through discipline and contemplation that activate bodily faculties, while its being hidden means veiled by the body.
rows.anchor: والحجر الأسود إشارة إلى الروح.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Stone's blackening through contact with menstruating women signifies spirit clouded by psychic powers dominating the heart and darkening its luminous face; Ishmael too was a monotheist, included in raising the House's foundations.
rows.anchor: واسوداده بملامسة النساء الحيض إشارة إلى اختفائه وتكدره بغلبة القوى النفسانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prayer asks God not to leave them to themselves, so submission comes through God's making rather than their own power.
rows.anchor: لا تكلنا إلى أنفسنا فنسلم بأنفسنا بل بك وبجعلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The requested messenger is Muhammad.
rows.anchor: هو محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، ولهذا قال عليه السلام:

rows.speaker: النبي محمد
rows.claim: Muhammad says he is Abraham's prayer, Jesus' glad tidings, and his mother's vision; she saw a light emerge and illuminate Syria's palaces.
rows.anchor: هو محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، ولهذا قال عليه السلام:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ramadan signifies the soul burning in the light of the Real.
rows.anchor: احتراق النفس بنور الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran is comprehensive, undifferentiated knowledge, the Quranic intellect leading to unity and guiding humanity through comprehensiveness.
rows.anchor: أي: العلم الجامع الإجمالي، المسمى بالعقل القرآني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clear signs are proofs of union and distinction: detailed knowledge called the discriminative or Furqanic intellect.
rows.anchor: ودلائل متصلة من الجمع والفرق، أي: العلم التفصيلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Witnessing the month means reaching the station of witnessing the Essence; fasting means refraining from speech, act, or movement not in God.
rows.anchor: أي: فليمسك عن قول وفعل وحركة ليس بالحق فيه

words: وَمَن كَانَ مَرِيضًا أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sick have heart diseases caused by psychic veils; travelers are still journeying and must traverse further stations before essential witnessing.
rows.anchor: أي: مبتلى بأمراض قلبه من الحجب النفسانية المانعة من ذلك الشهود

words: يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُمُ ٱلْيُسْرَ وَلَا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ ٱلْعُسْرَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ease is arrival at unity and extension through God's power; hardship is forcing deeds through the weak, incapable self.
rows.anchor: بالوصول إلى مقام التوحيد والامتداد بقدرة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Completing the count means completing successive stations, states, and ranks that lead to the goal.
rows.anchor: ولتتمموا تلك المراتب والأحوال والمقامات الموصلة

words: وَلِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Magnifying God means recognizing His greatness for guiding you to unity; gratitude is steadfastness in His command.
rows.anchor: ولتعظموا الله وتعرفوا عظمته وكبرياءه على هدايته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means when you have finished the pilgrimage rites.
rows.anchor: وفرغتم من الحج

words: فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَذِكْرِكُمْ ءَابَآءَكُمْ أَوْ أَشَدَّ ذِكْرًۭا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not remain occupied with lineage and worldly boasts that cloud time and harden hearts; sustain varied remembrance and study with companions, preserving purity and guiding others.
rows.anchor: فلا تكونوا كأهل العادة مشغولين بذكر الأنساب والمفاخرات

words: فَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some seek only worldly goods, remember the world, and worship for its sake; aiming low prevents receiving the higher because aspiration remains low and darkness conflicts with light.
rows.anchor: أي: لا يطلب إلا متاع الدنيا ولا يشتغل إلا بذكرها

words: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers have certainty, emigrate from the homelands of the self and familiar desires, and struggle against Satan's troops and the commanding soul.
rows.anchor: { وجاهدوا في سبيل الله } وجنود الشيطان والنفس الأمارة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They hope for theophanies of divine attributes and the lights of witnessing.
rows.anchor: أولئك يرجون رحمة الله } تجليات الصفات وأنوار المشاهدة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wine signifies caprice and love of the world; gambling signifies the soul's contrivance to secure its meager share.
rows.anchor: خمر الهوى وحب الدنيا وميسر احتيال النفس في جدب الحظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their sin is veiling and distance from God.
rows.anchor: قل فيهما إثم } الحجاب والبعد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their benefits are livelihood and psychic pleasure, including relief from troubling traits and worries through heedlessness.
rows.anchor: في باب المعاش وتحصيل اللذة النفسانية، والفرح بالذهول

words: الم تر إلى الذين خرجوا من ديارهم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those leaving their homes abandon familiar abodes, customary soul-stations, and worldly attachments at caprice's urging.
rows.anchor: أوطانهم المألوفة ومقار نفوسهم المعهودة ومقاماتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fearing death signifies ignorance, severance from true life, and falling into natural depths.
rows.anchor: الجهل والانقطاع عن الحياة الحقيقية والوقوع في المهاوي الطبيعية

words: فقال لهم الله موتوا ثم أحياهم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's command to die means voluntary death or annihilation of the self through theophany of the Essence, followed by true life, bestowed existence, and abiding after annihilation.
rows.anchor: أي: أمرهم بالموت الإرادي، أو أماتهم عن ذواتهم بالتجلي الذاتي

words: فقال لهم الله موتوا ثم أحياهم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, as in Ezra's story, they fled natural death, were killed, then their souls were joined to bodies of their kind to attain perfection.
rows.anchor: ولا يبعد أن يريد به ما أراد من قصة عزير،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Book's gradual descent raises the Prophet rank by rank to unitive knowledge, truth in its comprehensive aspect, called the Quranic intellect.
rows.anchor: أي: رقاك رتبة فرتبة، ودرجة فدرجة، بتنزيل الكتاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What came before is primordial eternal unity, known in the first covenant and stored in the unseen of original preparedness.
rows.anchor: من التوحيد الأزلي السابق المعلوم في العهد الأول المخزون في غيب الاستعداد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Torah and Gospel were sent down earlier, followed by the Furqan.
rows.anchor: وأنزل التوراة والإنجيل من قبل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Furqan is detailed, differentiated tawhid, called the Furqanic intellect and source of steadfastness and mission.
rows.anchor: التوحيد التفصيلي الذي هو الحق باعتبار الفرق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disbelievers are veiled from both forms of unity by appearances and created things, which are actually signs of unity; punishment is distance and deprivation.
rows.anchor: احتجبوا عن هذين التوحيدين بالمظاهر والأكوان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is overpowering; His vengeance cannot be described or fully apprehended.
rows.anchor: لا يقدر وصفه ولا يبلغ كنهه ولا يقدر على مثله

words: لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nothing in the two worlds is hidden from God, so He knows where retribution falls.
rows.anchor: في العالمين، فيعلم مواقع الانتقام

words: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى وَلَدٌۭ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul's astonishment at conceiving without a man means receiving birth without a human shaykh's discipline or teacher, preserving its virginity.
rows.anchor: تعجب النفس من حملها وولادتها من غير أن يمسها بشر،

words: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God chooses people through attraction and unveiling, granting the heart's station without instruction, as with the beloved and some lovers.
rows.anchor: يصطفي من شاء بالجذب والكشف ويهب له مقام القلب من غير تربية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine teaching gives rational sciences, legal wisdom, and Torah and Gospel knowledge, meaning outward and inward knowledge.
rows.anchor: كتاب العلوم المعقولة، وحكم الشرائع، ومعارف الكتب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus is a messenger to spiritually prepared people among Jacob's spiritual descendants.
rows.anchor: إلى المستعدين الروحانيين من أسباط يعقوب الروح

words: أَنِّى قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus' sign demonstrates that he comes from God.
rows.anchor: تدل على أني آتيكم من عنده

words: أَنِّىٓ أَخْلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creating from clay means educating, purifying, and training deficient prepared souls; the bird-shape is a soul yearning to fly toward holiness.
rows.anchor: بالتربية والتزكية والحكمة العملية من طين نفوس المستعدين الناقصين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Breathing into it imparts divine knowledge and true life through companionship and training; it becomes a living soul flying to God on longing and aspiration.
rows.anchor: من نفث العلم الإلهي ونفس الحياة الحقيقية بتأثير الصحبة والتربية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blind is veiled from truth, with an unopened inner eye; the leper is afflicted by vices, false beliefs, world-love, and desire, treated by spiritual medicine.
rows.anchor: المحجوب عن نور الحق الذي لم تنفتح عين بصيرته قط ولم تبصر شمس وجه الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The leper is defective through vice, false belief, love of the world, and desire's stain.
rows.anchor: المعيوب نفسه بمرض الرذائل والعقائد الفاسدة ومحبة الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Raising the dead signifies reviving ignorance with the life of knowledge, by God's permission.
rows.anchor: موتى الجهل بحياة العلم { بإذن الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What people eat is what they take through desire; what they store is the hidden motives and intentions within them.
rows.anchor: تتناولون من مباشرة الشهوات واللذات { وما تدخرون في بيوتكم } أي: في بيوت غيوبكم

words: وَمُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Torah here is outward knowledge; Jesus confirms it.
rows.anchor: أي: من توراة علم الظاهر

words: وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What Jesus makes lawful signifies some of the lights of inward knowledge.
rows.anchor: من أنوار الباطن { وجئتكم بآية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sign is tawhid, on which no prophet disagreed; they should fear God by not opposing Jesus and obey his call to unity.
rows.anchor: هو التوحيد الذي لم يخالفني فيه نبي قط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship means turning exclusively toward God and annihilating in Him, the utmost humility.
rows.anchor: خصصوه بالتوجه إليه، والفناء فيه، الذي هو غاية التذلل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Associating anything with God means asserting its independent existence.
rows.anchor: ولا تشركوا به شيئا } بإثبات وجوده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The parents are spirit and soul from which the heart is born; fulfill their rights by drawing from spirit and orienting to it, and purifying and protecting the soul from worldly love, greed, and Satan while restraining appetites.
rows.anchor: ووفوا حقوقهما وراعوهما حق المراعاة بالاستفاضة من الأول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Near kin are those like you in original preparedness and spiritual affinity.
rows.anchor: الذي يناسبكم في الحقيقة بحسب القرب في الاستعداد الأصلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Orphans are prepared people cut off by veiling from the holy spirit, their true father.
rows.anchor: المستعدين المنقطعين عن نور الروح القدسي الذي هو الأب الحقيقي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The needy are righteous people without a share in knowledge, gnosis, or realities; they are still and unable to travel, ending in the Garden of acts.
rows.anchor: أي: لا حظ من العلوم والمعارف والحقائق، فسكنوا ولم يقدروا على المسير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The near neighbor is at a spiritual station close to yours; the distant neighbor is far; the companion by your side shares your station and accompanies you.
rows.anchor: في مقام من مقامات السلوك، قريب من مقامك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The companion by your side shares your station and travels alongside you.
rows.anchor: والرفيق الذي هو في عين مقامكم ويرافقكم في سيركم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wayfarer travels the path of truth, estranged from the soul's home and not yet at a station of God's people.
rows.anchor: أي: السالك في طريق الحق، الداخل في الغربة عن مأوى النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those under one's right hand are one's people of will and love, servants deserving kindness suited to each.
rows.anchor: من أهل إرادتكم ومحبتكم، الذين هم عبيدكم كلا بما يناسبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, near kin are high malakut spirits, orphans spiritual faculties, and needy psychic faculties; near neighbor intellect, distant neighbor imagination, companion longing and will, wayfarer thought, and owned servants acquired virtues that source good acts.
rows.anchor: وإن شئت أولت ذي القربى بما يتصل به من الملكوت العالية من المجردات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The arrogant person advances by self-reliance rather than God and admires their own deeds.
rows.anchor: يسعى في السلوك بنفسه لا بالله، معجبا بأعماله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The boastful person delights in states, stations, and perfections, becoming veiled by seeing these qualities in themselves.
rows.anchor: مبتهجا بأحواله ومقاماته وكمالاته، محتجبا برؤيتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disbelievers are veiled from truth, and disobeying the Messenger is veiling from religion.
rows.anchor: بالاحتجاب عن الحق { وعصوا الرسول } بالاحتجاب عن الدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They wish the earth of preparedness leveled so their souls are erased or left blank of false beliefs and ruinous vices.
rows.anchor: أرض الاستعداد، فتنطمس نفوسهم أو تصير ساذجة لا نقش فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They cannot conceal any imprint in their souls to escape punishment for it.
rows.anchor: أي: لا يقدرون على كتم حديث من تلك النقوش حتى لا يتعذبون بعقابه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The address is to those with intellectual faith; a believer with direct faith would not be heedless in prayer.
rows.anchor: بالإيمان العلمي، فإن المؤمن بالإيمان العيني لا يكون في صلاته غافلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer means the station of presence and intimate conversation with God.
rows.anchor: لا تقربوا مقام الحضور والمناجاة مع الله في حال كونكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Drunkenness means sleep of heedlessness or intoxication with caprice and love of the world.
rows.anchor: من نوم الغفلة، أو من خمور الهوى ومحبة الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Before praying, know what you say and keep the heart from worldly occupations and distracting whispers.
rows.anchor: ولا تشتغل قلوبكم بأشغال الدنيا ووساوسها فتذهلوا عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sexual impurity means distance from truth through attachment to the soul and its pleasures; passing through means meeting only necessary needs, not being wholly absorbed in them.
rows.anchor: بعداء عن الحق بشدة الميل إلى النفس ومباشرة لذاتها وشهواتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Passing through worldly pleasures is limited to necessity and benefit, such as food, clothing, and procreation, to avoid being imprinted by total absorption.
rows.anchor: أي: مارين عليها، سالكي طريق من طرق تمتعاتها بقدر الضرورة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Washing means cleansing attachment to the lower realm through repentance, seeking forgiveness, and regret.
rows.anchor: أي: تتطهروا عن تلك الهيئة الحاصلة من الانجذاب إلى الجهة السفلية

words: وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰٓ أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Illness is false belief and deadly vice of the heart; travel is wandering in ignorance and confusion while greed seeks selfish pleasure and impure substance.
rows.anchor: القلوب، فاقدي سلامتها بأمراض العقائد الفاسدة والرذائل المهلكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Travel signifies wandering in ignorance and confusion to seek the soul's pleasure and impure matter through greed.
rows.anchor: في تيه الجهل والحيرة لطلب لذة النفس ومادة الرجس بالحرص

words: أَوْ جَآءَ أَحَدٌۭ مِّنكُم مِّنَ ٱلْغَآئِطِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Coming from the privy signifies engaging in tainted wealth and acquisition, with a lasting imprint of love and inclination.
rows.anchor: من الاشتغال بلوث المال وكسب الحطام ملوثا بهيئة محبته وميله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Touching women signifies attachment to souls and direct engagement in their pleasures and desires.
rows.anchor: لازمتم النفوس وباشرتموها في لذاتها وشهواتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lacking water means lacking knowledge that guides release from these states and purifies from them.
rows.anchor: علما يهديكم إلى التفصي منها ويهذبكم بالتطهر عنها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tayammum means turning toward pure preparedness and returning to the original innate disposition.
rows.anchor: فتوجهوا صعيد استعدادكم الطيب، واقصدوه وارجعوا إلى أصل الاستعداد الفطري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wiping means erasing acquired lower dispositions from the self and its descended attributes; the soil removes their traces and restores purity.
rows.anchor: أي: ذواتكم الموجودة وصفاتكم بالنزول ومحو هيئات العلق بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's pardon removes dark, entrenched dispositions when abandoned, clearing preparedness for encounter; His forgiveness veils creatures' attributes and essences with His own.
rows.anchor: يعفو عن تلك الهيئات المظلمة ورسوخ تلك الملكات الحاجبة بتركها والإعراض عنها
